:::{#exm-not-stationary-sequence}
#### An alternating sequence that starts at zero
<!-- no-figure: the example is a short argument with no data to plot -->

Let $X_1 = 0$, and let $X_t = 1 - X_{t-1}$ for each $t \ge 2$,
so the sequence is $0, 1, 0, 1, \ldots$ with [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $1$.
The sequence is not a [stationary sequence](#def-stationary-sequence):
with length $k = 1$ and shift $s = 1$,

$$\P(X_2 = 0) = 0,$$

but

$$\P(X_1 = 0) = 1.$$

:::
